title: Spicy Sausage Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic North African-inspired stew made with spicy sausage, fennel, and fragrant spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced fennel and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the spicy sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the ground koji, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
